_comment: Copy to secrets.json beside the exe (the project copies it on build if present). Never commit secrets.json.
_environment: Optional. 'live' (the default when absent or unrecognised - existing files keep working) or 'testnet'. 'testnet' selects the DeribitTestnet credential block and wss://test.deribit.com; if that block is missing the load FAILS (no silent fallback to live keys). The window title always shows the selected environment (— LIVE / — TESTNET).
